Boardwalk pretzel bites.d: Brushed with butter, served warm. Sharp cheddar dip, yellow mustard.
Boardwalk pretzel bites.note: Something warm for the long night.

Street-cart corn.d: Charred ribs off the cob, chili butter, lime, smoked salt.
Street-cart corn.note: Off the cart at the top of the boardwalk.
